ticket.summary: Two-handle bathroom lavatory faucet (1990s original) dripping from hot side; customer closed angle stops overnight, wants earliest normal appointment.
mitigation_advice: Close both angle-stop shutoff valves under the sink (clockwise) to stop the drip overnight
Leave the faucet handle in the off position and keep the stops closed until the tech arrives
Report to the tech if either stop fails to fully stop the drip (worn stop, cheap add-on replacement)

quote_lines.description: Two-handle lavatory faucet repair - stem washer/seat kit, hot side, includes diagnosis and standard parts
Contingency if 90s internals are unavailable/corroded: faucet replacement labor, fixture billed separately

ticket.customer_message: Perfect - two-handle means it's almost certainly a worn stem washer or seat on the hot side, the easy cheap end of the range: roughly $145-165, about an hour on site. We carry stems and seat kits for most 90s two-handle fixtures. Not weeks out at all - Tuesday Sept 1, 9:00-11:00 AM, or 1:00-3:00 PM if afternoon is better. I've penciled you in for 9-11 and dispatch will text to confirm in the morning. Leave the shutoff valves closed until we arrive, and tell the tech if either one doesn't fully stop the drip - that means the valve is worn too and it's a cheap fix while we're under there.
